:::{#thm-cosine-sine-identity}
#### The Pythagorean identity

For every real number $\angpar$
[@wikipedia_pythagorean_trigonometric_identity],

$$
\cos^2\angpar + \sin^2\angpar = 1.
$$

:::

::: proof

The point $(\cos\angpar, \sin\angpar)$ lies on the unit circle (@def-unit-circle),
so its coordinates satisfy $x_1^2 + x_2^2 = 1$.

:::
